name: rfd4_proteina_submit_design
description: Submit an RFD4-Proteina generative protein or binder design job to Vertex AI Pipelines. Supports unconditional monomer generation, motif scaffolding, and binder co-design against a target structure.

input.description: Input design specification in JSON/YAML format or path to file. If target_structure is provided, input can be omitted or used as override.

target_structure.description: Target structure identifier: 4-letter RCSB PDB ID (e.g. '6M1U'), GCS URI (gs://bucket/path.cif or .pdb), or local file path.

target_chains.description: Target protein chains to bind against (e.g. ['A'] or ['A', 'B']).

binding_residues.description: Target hotspot/interface residues in 'Chain:ResNum' or 'ResNum' format (e.g. ['A:23', 'A:24'] or ['23', '24']).

scaffold_motif.description: Motif specification for motif scaffolding mode, indicating fixed functional residues.

binder_length_range.description: Length range for designed protein/binder, e.g. '80..140' or '100' (default: '80..140').

job_name.description: Custom name for the Vertex AI Pipeline job. If omitted, an auto-generated timestamped name will be used.

num_model_seeds.description: Number of independent random seeds to run as parallel GPU tasks (default: 5).

num_designs_per_seed.description: Number of design trajectories to sample per seed task (default: 2).

gpu_type.description: GPU accelerator type: 'auto' (default, selects A100 40GB for <=1500 tokens, A100_80GB for >1500 tokens — A100 40GB provisions much faster than L4 under DWS FLEX_START), 'A100' (40GB), 'A100_80GB' (80GB), or 'L4' (explicit override only).

num_gpus.description: Number of GPUs per seed task (default: 1).

enable_flex_start.description: Enable Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS) Flex Start for up to 50% cost savings (default: true).

extra_cli_args.description: Additional CLI arguments to pass to RFD4-Proteina.

name: rfd4_proteina_analyze_job
description: Trigger parallel analysis of completed RFD4-Proteina binder designs using Cloud Run Jobs.

job_name.description: Pipeline job name or resource name.

analysis_tasks.description: Number of parallel Cloud Run tasks to run for analysis (default: 10).

force_reanalysis.description: Force re-running analysis even if cached results exist (default: false).

name: rfd4_proteina_get_analysis_results
description: Retrieve comprehensive analysis results, quality scores, ranking metrics, and Gemini expert interpretation for an RFD4-Proteina design job.

job_name.description: Pipeline job name or resource name.

name: rfd4_proteina_open_viewer
description: Get Cloud Run 3Dmol.js viewer URL to visually inspect RFD4-Proteina generated binder complexes, pLDDT coloring, and binding interfaces.

job_name.description: Pipeline job name or resource name.
